name: Humidity-varied DNA diffraction
summary: By controlling the humidity around DNA fibres during X-ray photography, Franklin and Gosling separated two forms, A and B, giving clearer patterns such as Photo 51.
description: Franklin and Gosling obtained DNA-fibre X-ray patterns under differing hydration, distinguishing crystalline A and wetter B configurations.
